body.message:
Thank you. I’d be happy to arrange a viewing, but I would also like to know what other options you currently have available.

I’m looking for a clean, modern, and preferably new apartment, either 1 or 2 bedrooms. I’m flexible with the payment terms, so please feel free to share the best options you currently have.

Could you also please share the monthly rent for each option and confirm what is included in the price, such as utilities, internet, and any other services? Please also let me know if there are any additional fees or deposits.
